_about: What the system says to the owner, in English. This file is complete: every other language falls back to it. Keys starting with _ are notes, never shown. {name} fields are filled in by the program; keep them as they are.
bridge.help: What you can do: send it again. If it keeps happening, send /new to start a clean conversation. /pending shows what is waiting.
bridge.claude_missing: I could not start: the `claude` program is not installed on this machine, or not found. Nothing was done. What you can do: install Claude Code and run `claude login` on the machine, then send your message again.
bridge.timed_out: I worked on this for {minutes} minutes without finishing, so I stopped. Some steps may be done and others not; an approval that was already taken will not be used a second time. What you can do: ask for a smaller step, or send /pending to see what is open.
bridge.claude_error: I could not finish this: the Claude program stopped with an error, so nothing more was done. {help} If the error below mentions signing in, run `claude login` on the machine.
bridge.conversation_lost: (The earlier conversation could not be found any more, so this answer starts a new one.)
bridge.new: New day, clean slate. What are we doing?
bridge.kept_timed_out: I worked on this for {minutes} minutes and was stopped before finishing.
bridge.kept_again: It has stopped several times now: a smaller step may work better.
bridge.still_open_file: (The work file is still marked unfinished: {files}. Send /continue to go on with it.)
bridge.left_over: (Unfinished work was left in {files}. Send /continue to go on with it.)
bridge.continue_no_number: There is no number {n}. Send /continue on its own to see what is unfinished.
bridge.continue_no_job: '{which}' has no unfinished work to continue. Send /continue on its own for the newest, or /schedule to see the jobs.
bridge.continue_nothing_cut: Nothing was cut off, so there is nothing to continue.
bridge.continue_nothing: Nothing was cut off or left unfinished, so there is nothing to continue.
bridge.going_on_file_task: Go on with the unfinished work in {file}
bridge.job_busy: A scheduled run is going right now ({job}). Send /continue {id} again in a few minutes.
bridge.going_on_job: Going on with {name}, unattended as scheduled: nothing goes out from it.
bridge.run_waiting: One moment: a scheduled run is finishing ({job}). Your message is next, within {minutes} minutes at most.
bridge.approved:
Approved: {what}
{name} picks it up within about {minutes} minutes. Until then: /undo_{id}
bridge.sent_back:
Sent back with your note: {what}
The corrected version will come to you again.
bridge.dropped:
Dropped: {what}
Your reason is saved for the team. /undo_{id} takes it back.
bridge.undone: Undone. It is waiting for your decision again: {what}
bridge.no_such_item: There is no item '{id}'. /pending shows what is waiting.
bridge.nothing_to_decide: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
bridge.ask_drop: Why are you dropping it? One sentence; the team learns from it.
bridge.ask_next:
{what}
{ask} Send it as your next message.
bridge.file_kinds: I can only take text files, PDFs, Excel workbooks and photos ({kinds}). Nothing was saved. Send it as one of these (an old .xls: save it as .xlsx first), or paste the text.
bridge.file_too_big: This file is {kb} kB; the limit is {limit} kB. Nothing was saved. Split it, or send the part that matters.
bridge.file_not_pdf: This does not read as a PDF, so nothing was saved. Send it again, or paste the text instead.
bridge.file_not_xlsx: This does not read as an Excel workbook (.xlsx), so nothing was saved. Send it again, or paste the text instead.
bridge.file_not_text: This does not read as a text file, so nothing was saved. Send it again, or paste the text instead.
bridge.file_download: I could not download the file from Telegram, so nothing was saved. Send it again.
bridge.photo_heic: This is a HEIC photo (the iPhone format), which the agent cannot look at. Nothing was saved. Send it as a photo instead of a file (Telegram turns it into JPEG), or export it as JPEG first.
bridge.photo_too_big: This image is {kb} kB; the limit is {limit} kB. Nothing was saved. Send it as a photo, or a smaller copy.
bridge.photo_not_image: This does not read as an image, so nothing was saved. Send it again as a photo.
bridge.photo_download: I could not download the image from Telegram, so nothing was saved. Send it again.
status.working_hand_over: Working now: carrying out what you approved, for {for_} (since {since}).
status.working_job: Working now: a scheduled run ({job}), for {for_} (since {since}).
status.idle: Not working on anything right now.
status.pending: Waiting for your decision: {n}. /pending shows them.
status.no_pending: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
status.pending_unknown: Waiting for your decision: could not be read just now. /pending tries again.
status.unfinished: Unfinished work: {n}. /continue goes on with it.
status.unfinished_unknown: Unfinished work: could not be read just now.
status.next_unknown: Next scheduled: could not be read just now. /schedule tries again.
alerts.waiting:
Waiting for your decision:
{rows}

/ok {id} · /change {id} what to change · /drop {id} why
Or use the dashboard.
alerts.approvals_set_aside: brain/approvals.json could not be read and was set aside as {name}. Anything that was waiting in it has to be asked again. Delete that file once you have looked at it.
approvals.unreadable: {error}. Nothing can be approved or carried out until it is fixed or replaced.
approvals.bad_decision: the decision is ok, edit or drop
approvals.drop_needs_reason: dropping needs a reason: one sentence the team can learn from
approvals.too_late: '{id}' is already {status}; it can no longer be undone
approvals.draft_mark: the text starts with a draft marker ("{mark}")
approvals.status_edit: sent back for a change, not picked up yet
autonomy.label.archive_lessons: Move old lessons to the archive
autonomy.unreadable: {error}. The fresh-install levels are in use until the file is fixed.
sched.off_owner_bad: your setting in config/business.yaml is not understood ({error})
sched.off_pack_bad: the pack's time is not understood ({error})
sched.off_all: all scheduled runs are switched off (schedule.enabled: false in config/business.yaml)
sched.off_sources: none of the jobs it sums up runs ({jobs})
sched.off_quiet: its time is inside the quiet hours ({quiet}), so it never runs
sched.need_no_competitors: the owner has not named competitors yet (brain/watch/competitors.md, from the onboarding)
sched.need_unknown: '{need}' is not a need this version knows
sched.change_hint: Change a time or switch one off in config/business.yaml (schedule.jobs); see config/business.example.yaml.
sched.resume_no_job: There is no scheduled job '{id}'. /schedule lists them.
sched.resume_busy: Another run is going right now. Send /continue again in a minute.
sched.resume_nothing: '{name}' has no unfinished work to continue: its last run did not stop half-way, or the work file was finished since.
sched.problem_failed: The scheduled run '{name}' failed: {note}. It tries again at its next time; /schedule shows the details.
sched.problem_left_nothing: The scheduled run '{name}' did not leave what it should: {note}. It tries again at its next time; /schedule shows the details.
memory.title: Move {n} old lines of brain/lessons.md to the archive
memory.summary: brain/lessons.md is over its cap. Nothing moves without your /ok.
memory.notice_size: brain/lessons.md is {size} bytes, the cap is {cap}. /ok moves these {n} oldest lines to brain/lessons.archive.md: they leave the prompt, search still finds them.
memory.notice_pin: Keep a rule always: put {pin} at the end of its line in brain/lessons.md (it then stays, also after /ok).
memory.notice_raise: Room for all: raise JINNEE_MEMORY_LESSONS_BYTES in .env (now {cap}) and restart; this request then closes itself.
memory.notice_ok: Fine as it is: /ok. Not now: /drop with a reason, and I ask again in {days} days at the earliest.
memory.notice_dashboard: The full list is on the dashboard.
memory.changed: [{id}] Nothing moved from brain/lessons.md. I take a change as "not now": I ask again in {days} days at the earliest. To keep a rule always, put {pin} at the end of its line.
memory.failed: [{id}] I could not move the lines, so brain/lessons.md is as it was. It is noted as failed.
memory.done: [{id}] Done: {n} old lines of brain/lessons.md are in brain/lessons.archive.md, where search still finds them.
memory.done_kept: {kept} stayed (pinned, changed or no longer needed).
workfile.no_steps: • {file}: started, no step list in it
dash.no_brief: No brief yet today. It arrives at 8:00, or message {name} on Telegram.
dash.not_sendable: Not sendable as it is: {warning}. Approving will not send it.
dash.nothing_waiting: Nothing waiting for you. That's good.
dash.no_team: No one has checked in yet. After the first task you'll see who is doing what.
dash.schedule_unreadable: The schedule could not be read. Run python3 core/scheduler.py plan on the machine.
dash.orders_summary: {orders} orders (14 days) · {revenue} {currency} · no invoice: {no_invoice} · no label yet: {no_label}
dash.no_orders: No orders in the last 14 days.
dash.ask_drop: Why are you dropping it? One sentence. The team reads it and learns from it.
dash.err_local_only: No DASHBOARD_PASSWORD set: the dashboard only answers direct requests to localhost
